Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath

For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ritesh Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Jitendra Pandey, A.P. P.
--------
02/ Dated 08.09.2025 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Kersai P.S. Case No. 06 of 2024,
corresponding to POCSO Case No.14 of 2024, for the offence registered under Sections 376(DA) &
506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum- Special Judge, (POCSO Act), Simdega.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum- Special Judge, (POCSO Act), Simdega
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: On 05.03.2024, petitioner alongwith co-accused persons are alleged to have gang raped 16 years old daughter of the informant.
Considering the nature of allegation, I am not inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly,
the prayer for bail of the petitioner is hereby rejected.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) BS/-
